confidence.rationale: TabId on the upstream head falls back to Title when Page.Id is empty, while child caching and selection preservation key on TabId. The fork-side patch at 9dbbfcb9 demonstrates a tested per-position fallback identity fix.

proposed_comments.title: Make fallback tab identities unique
proposed_comments.body:
### Make fallback tab identities unique

**Severity:** `medium`

TabViewModel.TabId currently falls back to the tab title when the hosted page has no Id, and TabbedPageViewModel then uses that value as both the child-cache key and the identity to preserve selection across ItemsChanged. If an extension exposes two tabs with the same title and no page id, activating the second tab can reuse the first tab's cached child and dynamic updates can preserve the wrong tab. Please derive a per-position fallback identity and add a regression test covering duplicate-title tabs without page IDs.

confidence.rationale: Copilot flagged that activeId is captured before dispatching to the UI scheduler, so a queued ItemsChanged update can restore an older selection after the user changes tabs.

proposed_comments.title: Read the selected tab inside the dispatched tab refresh
proposed_comments.body:
### Read the selected tab inside the dispatched tab refresh

**Severity:** `medium`

TabbedPageViewModel samples `SelectedTab?.TabId` before scheduling the UI-thread update. If the user switches tabs while that callback is queued, the update can restore the older activeId and unexpectedly jump the selection back. Please capture the current selected tab inside the dispatched action immediately before replacing `Tabs` and preserving the active child.

confidence.rationale: The tabbed page view path forces full collection on navigation, unlike the existing list-page cleanup path that uses the debounced background ExtensionObjectReleaser.AfterNavigation().

proposed_comments.title: Avoid full synchronous collection on tabbed-page navigation
proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid full synchronous collection on tabbed-page navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

The tabbed page view path performs synchronous full collection on the UI thread when navigating away, which can pause navigation unpredictably. Please use the same debounced background `ExtensionObjectReleaser.AfterNavigation()` cleanup path used by the list-page flow instead of forcing collection from the tabbed-page view.

confidence.rationale: The documentation diagram says ITab derives from ITabbedPage, but the interfaces define ITabbedPage.GetTabs returning ITab objects.

proposed_comments.title: Correct the ITab/ITabbedPage relationship in the SDK spec
proposed_comments.body:
### Correct the ITab/ITabbedPage relationship in the SDK spec

**Severity:** `low`

The SDK spec diagram shows `ITab` inheriting from `ITabbedPage`, which contradicts the interfaces above it. The relationship is containment: an `ITabbedPage` returns multiple `ITab` objects. Please change the diagram to a composition/association relationship.
